Actual official federation member identity/history body read. City University London became City, University of London on joining the federation in September 2016; City and St George’s merged in August 2024 to become current City St George’s, University of London. Degree academic-direction relationship is separate, not identity with the federal University of London.

limitations: Bayes is a constituent school; university name normalized to its verified parent. The operations group page contains some older research-history descriptions alongside current school branding.

Historical City names are documented predecessor aliases for directory presentation. This does not rewrite individual award/employment labels, infer continuous employment, or transfer federal University of London awards. Current doctoral branch coverage remains separately incomplete.
